scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter functions typecheck && pnpm --filter tests exec tsc --noEmit && node scripts/with-env.mjs .env.emulator pnpm --filter site check
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter functions test && pnpm --filter site test
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-ajith "pnpm --filter tests exec vitest run -c vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.test:functions: pnpm build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project demo-ajith "pnpm --filter tests exec vitest run -c vitest.functions.config.ts"
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build:emu && pnpm build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project demo-ajith "pnpm --filter tests exec playwright test --trace off"
scripts.check:prod: ASTRO_OUT_DIR=./dist-prod node scripts/with-env.mjs .env.example pnpm --filter site build && node scripts/check-prod-bundle.mjs site/dist-prod
